subject: Update on Export Control and the Encord platform at Helsing
text:
Hello James,

Thank you again for your patience and understanding while we investigated our Export Control requirements.

We have determined that data similar to our export-controlled sets can be collected under non-export-controlled restrictions. Due to the high costs associated with annotating export-controlled data, we have decided to proceed with the non-restricted data for
 the time being. As a result, we will continue using V7 as our annotation platform.

Should our requirements change, I will be sure to let you know. It has been a pleasure working with you and learning about Encord. We now have a clear understanding of your platform as a viable alternative for export-controlled data should the need arise in
 the future.

Please feel free to reach out if you have any questions.

Best regards,

Olle Holmberg
